quarantine.reason: duplicate re-description of an already-recorded session stamped under a fresh calendar date (UTC-date-on-a-PT-evening-run stamp; forward-ledger calendar-asof audit 2026-08-05)

pre_fix_stamp: pre-fix rows were stamped from contract['asof'] = datetime.now(timezone.utc); the nightly runs 20:00-22:30 PT so the UTC date was already the next calendar day — all 13 committed row batches were committed on the PT evening BEFORE the date they stamped (e.g. commit 2026-08-03T21:30 PT -> rows stamped 2026-08-04), leaving the ledger +1 against the tape with 180/780 rows on weekend dates
residual: conservative rule: only stamps that committed frames prove were never a session for that ticker were moved; a stamp naming a real session one bar after the tape it describes is indistinguishable in the frame index and was left in place

known_gaps.reason: the calendar date is not evidence about that session: the run that wrote these rows read tape no newer than the restamped session (no frame bar after 2026-08-05), so whether this session had real fresh-Stage-2 candidates is unknowable from committed data
